label_source: human (IndEgo manifest_gold n=150 + Egocentric-10K ood160_labels.json n=160: 138 good / 22 bad, 47 factories; merge of q1=60 + q2=100, single labeller)
protocol: signed AUROC per feature, label 1 = usable/good; IndEgo CI = clip-bootstrap (7 clips); OOD-160 CI = FACTORY-GROUPED bootstrap (honest, n_boot=2000, seed=0), window-bootstrap kept as the optimistic comparison. E5.03 class rule.
device: CPU (numpy/sklearn; decode done by the O/Z agents, no GPU here)
title: Z3 family verdicts on OOD-160

verdicts_160.compression: relative frame-size variability (ct_fsize_std) stable; absolute bitrate/frame-size flip (as at n=60)
verdicts_160.affine: raw motion residuals (translation-only and full-affine, global and hand-restricted) flip; only hand-region motion EXCESS is stable
verdicts_160.invariants: exposure-clipping / Laplacian sharpness / histogram entropy stable; noise-SNR and dHash flip
